preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i <= n for p_i in parents)
preconditions.description: Each parent index is between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= n-1 for c_i in counts)
preconditions.description: Each count is between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is either 'YES' or 'NO' depending on whether a solution exists.

postconditions.expression: possible implies len(return_value[1]) == n and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in return_value[1])
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the second line contains n integers between 1 and 10^9.
If no solution exists, the second line is empty.
